thread:
Omar: Heads-up from PartnerCorp: after we migrated their account to the new marketplace plan yesterday, their daily usage for 2025-07-14 shows a ~12% lag versus their internal meter. They provided sample request_ids. cc @sam-metering @claire-billing
Yvonne: Sent request_ids privately. They say the missing counts are mostly between 03:00-05:00 UTC.
Sam: Quick note: we switched the legacy-plan adapter to use the new ingestion topic on the 14th at 02:45 UTC. There's a consumer group rebalance at 02:48 that might've dropped in-flight batches.
Claire: If ingestion missed events, billing will show less usage, partner disputes us. Partner claims they were charged for plan migration fees but not showing usage credit; need clarity.
webhook-bot: alert: consumer_rebalance detected on topic=ingest-legacy at 2025-07-14T02:48:19Z, group=legacy-adapter, reason=coordinator-trigger
Sam: Can we replay raw topic partition for partner namespace? I can run targeted replay for partitions covering those request_ids. ETA ~1h.
Omar: Partner wants ETA and whether we'll auto-credit if backfill fails. Policy: backfill then credit if gap > SLA threshold.
Yvonne: Partner asked for daily reconciliation sheet. Can we provide interim numbers?
Sam: Running quick scan: 2025-07-14 03:00-05:00 UTC raw events exist but some batches show dup_flag=true and others missing idempotency_key. I suspect the adapter emitted partial batches during rebalance.
Claire: Estimate impact?
Sam: Preliminary: counting raw -> rollup delta is -11.7% for that window for PartnerCorp account. If replay restores, we'll reconcile. If not, billing team to prepare prorated credit.
Omar: I'll notify partner: "We're investigating consumer-rebalance during migration window. We'll run a targeted replay and follow up with reconciliation by EOD."
webhook-bot: replay job queued: job_id=replay-3789991111-1 status=queued
Yvonne: Partner appreciated the quick update. Please cc me on final reconciliation so I can close the billing dispute.
Sam: Starting replay now. Will report results.
Claire: Billing hold placed on disputed charges for PartnerCorp until reconciliation completes.
Omar: Thanks team. Follow-ups: 1) replay and reconcile, 2) postmortem for legacy-adapter rebalance handling, 3) ensure migration playbook adds drain-before-switch step.
